verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן אֱלִיפַ֥ז הַֽתֵּימָנִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said:

verses.he: הֶֽחָכָ֗ם יַעֲנֶ֥ה דַֽעַת־ר֑וּחַ וִֽימַלֵּ֖א קָדִ֣ים בִּטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Should a wise man make answer with windy knowledge, And fill his belly with the east wind?

verses.he: הוֹכֵ֣חַ בְּ֭דָבָר לֹ֣א יִסְכּ֑וֹן וּ֝מִלִּ֗ים לֹא־יוֹעִ֥יל בָּֽם׃
verses.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, Or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

verses.he: אַף־אַ֭תָּה תָּפֵ֣ר יִרְאָ֑ה וְתִגְרַ֥ע שִׂ֝יחָ֗ה לִפְנֵי־אֵֽל׃
verses.en: Yea, thou doest away with fear, And impairest devotion before God.

verses.he: כִּ֤י יְאַלֵּ֣ף עֲו‍ֹנְךָ֣ פִ֑יךָ וְ֝תִבְחַ֗ר לְשׁ֣וֹן עֲרוּמִֽים׃
verses.en: For thine iniquity teacheth thy mouth, And thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

verses.he: יַרְשִֽׁיעֲךָ֣ פִ֣יךָ וְלֹא־אָ֑נִי וּ֝שְׂפָתֶ֗יךָ יַעֲנוּ־בָֽךְ׃
verses.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I; Yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

verses.he: הֲרִאישׁ֣וֹן אָ֭דָם תִּוָּלֵ֑ד וְלִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתָּ׃
verses.en: Art thou the first man that was born? Or wast thou brought forth before the hills?

verses.he: הַבְס֣וֹד אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּשְׁמָ֑ע וְתִגְרַ֖ע אֵלֶ֣יךָ חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.en: Dost thou hearken in the council of God? And dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

verses.he: מַה־יָּ֭דַעְתָּ וְלֹ֣א נֵדָ֑ע תָּ֝בִ֗ין וְֽלֹא־עִמָּ֥נוּ הֽוּא׃
verses.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? What understandest thou, which is not in us?

verses.he: גַּם־שָׂ֣ב גַּם־יָשִׁ֣ישׁ בָּ֑נוּ כַּבִּ֖יר מֵאָבִ֣יךָ יָמִֽים׃
verses.en: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, Much older than thy father.

verses.he: הַמְעַ֣ט מִ֭מְּךָ תַּנְחֻמ֣וֹת אֵ֑ל וְ֝דָבָ֗ר לָאַ֥ט עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: Are the consolations of God too small for thee, And the word that dealeth gently with thee?

verses.he: מַה־יִּקָּחֲךָ֥ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּֽמַה־יִּרְזְמ֥וּן עֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: Why doth thy heart carry thee away? And why do thine eyes wink?

verses.he: כִּֽי־תָשִׁ֣יב אֶל־אֵ֣ל רוּחֶ֑ךָ וְהֹצֵ֖אתָ מִפִּ֣יךָ מִלִּֽין׃
verses.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, And lettest such words go out of thy mouth.

verses.he: מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־יִזְכֶּ֑ה וְכִֽי־יִ֝צְדַּ֗ק יְל֣וּד אִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.en: What is man, that he should be clean? And he that is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

verses.he: הֵ֣ן בקדשו [בִּ֭קְדֹשָׁיו] לֹ֣א יַאֲמִ֑ין וְ֝שָׁמַ֗יִם לֹא־זַכּ֥וּ בְעֵינָֽיו׃
verses.en: Behold, He putteth no trust in His holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in His sight.

verses.he: אַ֭ף כִּֽי־נִתְעָ֥ב וְֽנֶאֱלָ֑ח אִישׁ־שֹׁתֶ֖ה כַמַּ֣יִם עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: How much less one that is abominable and impure, Man who drinketh iniquity like water! .

verses.he: אֲחַוְךָ֥ שְֽׁמַֽע־לִ֑י וְזֶֽה־חָ֝זִ֗יתִי וַאֲסַפֵּֽרָה׃
verses.en: I will tell thee, hear thou me; And that which I have seen I will declare—

verses.he: אֲשֶׁר־חֲכָמִ֥ים יַגִּ֑ידוּ וְלֹ֥א כִֽ֝חֲד֗וּ מֵאֲבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.en: Which wise men have told From their fathers, and have not hid it;

verses.he: לָהֶ֣ם לְ֭בַדָּם נִתְּנָ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ וְלֹא־עָ֖בַר זָ֣ר בְּתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.en: Unto whom alone the land was given, And no stranger passed among them.

verses.he: כָּל־יְמֵ֣י רָ֭שָׁע ה֣וּא מִתְחוֹלֵ֑ל וּמִסְפַּ֥ר שָׁ֝נִ֗ים נִצְפְּנ֥וּ לֶעָרִֽיץ׃
verses.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, Even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

verses.he: קוֹל־פְּחָדִ֥ים בְּאָזְנָ֑יו בַּ֝שָּׁל֗וֹם שׁוֹדֵ֥ד יְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: A sound of terrors is in his ears: In prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

verses.he: לֹא־יַאֲמִ֣ין שׁ֭וּב מִנִּי־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וצפו [וְצָפ֖וּי] ה֣וּא אֱלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, And he is waited for of the sword.

verses.he: נֹ֘דֵ֤ד ה֣וּא לַלֶּ֣חֶם אַיֵּ֑ה יָדַ֓ע׀ כִּֽי־נָכ֖וֹן בְּיָד֣וֹ יֽוֹם־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.en: He wandereth abroad for bread: ‘Where is it?’ He knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

verses.he: יְֽ֭בַעֲתֻהוּ צַ֣ר וּמְצוּקָ֑ה תִּ֝תְקְפֵ֗הוּ כְּמֶ֤לֶךְ׀ עָתִ֬יד לַכִּידֽוֹר׃
verses.en: Distress and anguish overwhelm him; They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

verses.he: כִּֽי־נָטָ֣ה אֶל־אֵ֣ל יָד֑וֹ וְאֶל־שַׁ֝דַּ֗י יִתְגַּבָּֽר׃
verses.en: Because he hath stretched out his hand against God, And behaveth himself proudly against the Almighty;

verses.he: יָר֣וּץ אֵלָ֣יו בְּצַוָּ֑אר בַּ֝עֲבִ֗י גַּבֵּ֥י מָֽגִנָּֽיו׃
verses.en: He runneth upon him with a stiff neck, With the thick bosses of his bucklers.

verses.he: כִּֽי־כִסָּ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּחֶלְבּ֑וֹ וַיַּ֖עַשׂ פִּימָ֣ה עֲלֵי־כָֽסֶל׃
verses.en: Because he hath covered his face with his fatness, And made collops of fat on his loins;

verses.he: וַיִּשְׁכּ֤וֹן׀ עָ֘רִ֤ים נִכְחָד֗וֹת בָּ֭תִּים לֹא־יֵ֣שְׁבוּ לָ֑מוֹ אֲשֶׁ֖ר הִתְעַתְּד֣וּ לְגַלִּֽים׃
verses.en: And he hath dwelt in desolate cities, In houses which no man would inhabit, Which were ready to become heaps.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יֶ֖עְשַׁר וְלֹא־יָק֣וּם חֵיל֑וֹ וְלֹֽא־יִטֶּ֖ה לָאָ֣רֶץ מִנְלָֽם׃
verses.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, Neither shall their produce bend to the earth.

verses.he: לֹֽא־יָס֨וּר׀ מִנִּי־חֹ֗שֶׁךְ יֹֽ֭נַקְתּוֹ תְּיַבֵּ֣שׁ שַׁלְהָ֑בֶת וְ֝יָס֗וּר בְּר֣וּחַ פִּֽיו׃
verses.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; The flame shall dry up his branches, And by the breath of His mouth shall he go away.

verses.he: אַל־יַאֲמֵ֣ן בשו [בַּשָּׁ֣יו] נִתְעָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁ֝֗וְא תִּהְיֶ֥ה תְמוּרָתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: Let him not trust in vanity, deceiving himself; For vanity shall be his recompense.

verses.he: בְּֽלֹא־י֭וֹמוֹ תִּמָּלֵ֑א וְ֝כִפָּת֗וֹ לֹ֣א רַעֲנָֽנָה׃
verses.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, And his branch shall not be leafy.

verses.he: יַחְמֹ֣ס כַּגֶּ֣פֶן בִּסְר֑וֹ וְיַשְׁלֵ֥ךְ כַּ֝זַּ֗יִת נִצָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, And shall cast off his flower as the olive.

verses.he: כִּֽי־עֲדַ֣ת חָנֵ֣ף גַּלְמ֑וּד וְ֝אֵ֗שׁ אָכְלָ֥ה אָֽהֳלֵי־שֹֽׁחַד׃
verses.en: For the company of the godless shall be desolate, And fire shall consume the tents of bribery.

verses.he: הָרֹ֣ה עָ֭מָל וְיָ֣לֹד אָ֑וֶן וּ֝בִטְנָ֗ם תָּכִ֥ין מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity, And their belly prepareth deceit.
